title: Add benchmark-lab mixed-workload runners and reporting pipeline
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Add representative mixed-workload runners to the benchmark-lab to better exercise real production traffic patterns (concurrent text-generation, embeddings, and streaming chat) and extend the reporting pipeline to ingest these results into the performance dashboard. This change introduces workload runner templates, profiling baseline harnesses for cold/warm start, a reporting pipeline job, and associated docs and dashboards. Scope: - new benchmark runners under benchmark-lab/runners/mixed-workload (python) - profiling baselines and fixtures under benchmark-lab/profiling - reporting pipeline glue under benchmark-lab/pipeline (k8s job + airflow DAG) - metrics exporter and tags for session-level tracing - unit + integration tests and CI job updates Testing & results: - Local and CI unit tests: pass. - Integration job ran in staging cluster: median latency and throughput results collected and exported to reporting pipeline. - Profiling baseline (cold/warm) established for 4 representative models (redwood-small, redwood-medium, open-llama-7B, replit-13B-quant). Rollout plan: Merge to main and deploy reporting pipeline to staging for 48h smoke testing, then schedule run for production reporting during maintenance window. See linked linear tasks for rollout timeline and validation criteria.
commits: a1b2c3f: add mixed-workload runner skeleton and README
d4e5f6a: implement embeddings + streaming concurrency harness
f7a8b9c: add profiling baseline fixtures and sample manifests
0a1b2c3: reporting pipeline DAG + k8s job + metrics exporter
4d5e6f7: update CI workflows and test matrix
review_comments: Julian Chen (reviewer): Can we split the reporting DAG into smaller tasks? The current DAG has long-running steps which make retries difficult. Author reply: Split the longest step into two subtasks and added idempotent markers to make retries safe. See commit f7a8b9c.

Diego Alvarez (reviewer): The CI integration test timed out on the first run in staging. Please add a retry and a shorter smoke path. Author reply: Added a lightweight smoke test that runs on every PR and kept the full integration test gated behind a schedule; CI now re-runs and passes.
Priya Natarajan (reviewer): Please document the baseline measurement methodology in docs. Author reply: Added docs/benchmark-lab/mixed-workload.md with methodology and interpretation guidance.
release_notes:
- Added mixed-workload runners to benchmark-lab
- Added profiling baselines for cold/warm start
- Added reporting pipeline DAG and k8s job to ingest mixed-workload results
- Added metrics exporter tags for session-level tracing
